author: vGassen
description:
This dataset contains verbatim transcripts in Dutch from plenary sessions of the European Parliament. It includes both speeches originally delivered in Dutch and those translated into Dutch by the European Parliament’s official services. The focus is on capturing the spoken content of debates, excluding procedural remarks and attendance records.

author: vGassen
description:
Dutch-European-Parliament-Minutes: Adopted Texts Only
This dataset contains cleaned Dutch-language records of adopted texts from plenary sessions of the European Parliament. The content is extracted directly from official European Parliament XML files, omitting procedural notes and attendance lists to retain only substantive parts of the discussions.
Dataset Details
Language: Dutch

author: rostislavfisher
description:
🕊️ Hungary government supportance
This dataset contains information about the support for the current Hungarian government among Members of the European Parliament (MEPs).
For the analysis, debates in the European Parliament concerning Hungary were used. The entire analysis was conducted by a model, therefore some ambiguous statements may have been incorrectly assessed. The expected error rate is no more than 10%.

author: dess-mannheim
description:
Description
	

This dataset provides personas for politicians in the 2024 European Parliament, along with translated speeches delivered by representatives of the various European political groups. It also includes fictional counterfactual speeches generated by Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, as well as the detected stance of the original speech.
The dataset can be used to simulate the European Parliament using large language models (LLMs). The code is available at:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/dess-mannheim/european_parliament_simulation.
